rules.name: auth-reply-field-discarded
rules.description: a token/session verification call discards part or all of its reply. Partial: a binding with blank `_` targets (Go `_, _, ok :=`, Scala `val (_, _, ok) =` — detected from statement text, Scala drops `_` from the graph) — either the VERIFIED principal is discarded (callers then substitute a caller-controlled header/cookie value for the same role: the cache-hit account-swap shape) or the verification error is. Total: the call in bare statement position — the verdict itself is unused. Census rules: every partial hit needs 'where does the value filling that role actually come from?'; every statement-position hit needs 'does the callee return its verdict/claims (bug or unbound-claims hygiene) or Unit-and-throws (correct usage — the dominant FP class, one check per CALLEE not per site)?'
